articles.title: NASA’s Hubble Detects First-Ever Spin Reversal of Tiny Comet
articles.summary: Astronomers using NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope have found evidence that the spinning of a small comet slowed and then reversed its direction of rotation, offering a dramatic example of how volatile activity can affect the spin and physical evolution of small bodies in the solar system.
